entries.heading: A local educational
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 18006.  A local educational 
agency, State, institution of higher education, or other entity that 
receives funds under ``Education Stabilization Fund'', shall to the 
greatest extent practicable,

[[Page 134 STAT. 569]]

continue to pay its employees and contractors during the period of any 
disruptions or closures related to coronavirus.
